description: arXiv:2609.39559v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we study the problem of MAPFC, a post-optimization step for Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) plans where we are given a feasible plan produced by a modern MAPF solver and are tasked with removing avoidable moves while preserving feasibility. This NP-hard problem naturally arises when using learning-based state-of-the-art (SOTA) solvers...
author: Oren Salzman
